scope: Symbolic and signal measurements of unchanged submitted files; no human or model listening claim.

definitions.bar_numbering: 1-based from the first submitted bar; B bars 1-8 are the original prompt, 9-32 are generated.
definitions.primary_stats: Original manifest tokens, identical to music_quality_review: onsets count once each; MIDI pitch; velocity = 4*Vel_token+2; unweighted note-onset PC histogram; NumPy linear-interpolated 95th percentile.
definitions.rhythm: SET of Pos8 onset positions per annotated-beat bar, ignoring pitch/duration/velocity/multiplicity; matching sets do not mean identical music.
definitions.wav_time: Time since start of submitted WAV; waveform starts at MIDI time 0. MIDI musical endpoint excludes the approximately 2-second sound-release tail.
definitions.exact_midi: All actual MIDI pitch multisets and note totals are asserted equal to tokens. Per-bar MIDI onsets use 1 ms boundary tolerance for export rounding; original prompt velocity may differ from the quantized token reconstruction.
definitions.register: MIDI 96 = C7; a descriptive register marker, not a universal quality limit. Pitch comparisons do not establish perceived quality.
definitions.chord: Original, unmodified HW2_scripts/eval_bonus.py: 24 major/minor triads, duration*velocity weighted chroma with BASS_WEIGHT, cosine similarity; reference is maximum-overlap-duration annotation label per bar. Chord annotations are read for post-generation evaluation only.
definitions.reference: The 45 center-nearest 32-bar source crops were included in final all896-song fitting. Register comparisons are descriptive, not held-out generalization.

register_summary.sample_selection: Extreme: greatest whole-piece p95 pitch, ties lexical sample ID. Typical: nearest whole-piece p95 pitch to the 20-piece median, ties lexical ID. Selection diagnoses register only, not overall quality.

bonus.case_selection: Pre-specified from the independent review: 004 has zero official CA; 009 has CA 0.25. Bar examples are first two failures for which GT-estimator agrees with the annotation and first two generated successes, in chronological order.
bonus.discussion: The estimator reports agreement with the supplied bar-dominant major/minor chord label. A mismatch does not prove every note is wrong or exclude a valid reharmonization; the comparison with the same estimator on GT piano helps expose estimator limitations. Repeated onset-position patterns are not repeated full music bars.

report_discussion.register: The t12 setting minimizes the preregistered combined mean H4/GS reference gap among the tested settings, yet its register remains broader and higher than the 45-song reference: mean piece-level pitch p95 is 92.39 versus 78.36, a 14.02-semitone gap. The mean per-piece share of onsets at MIDI 96 or above is 3.50% versus 0.033%. H4 collapses octave information into pitch classes and GS only uses onset positions, so neither proxy can expose this register mismatch. The extreme and median-p95 examples are selected by stated rules rather than listening preference; no pitch clipping or other postprocessing has been applied.
report_discussion.harmony: Bonus 004 matches none of the 16 annotated bar chords; 009 matches 4/16. The exact same 24-triad estimator on GT piano is shown alongside each example, so agreement failures are not automatically equated with perceptual dissonance. The relatively high pitch-class OA reflects distribution overlap, not correct note or chord alignment. Better conditioning should be tested on training-only validation tunes using chord-aware or phrase-aware objectives before sampling settings are selected.
report_discussion.continuation: All nine continuations are compared across the original 8-bar prompt and three generated 8-bar windows. This extends the local two-bar seam criterion to density, pitch, dynamics, and onset-set repetition across the full 24-bar continuation. For prompt 003 at t12, density falls from 33.875 to 9.250 notes/bar and mean pitch rises from 69.08 to 85.27 between the first and last generated windows. The original selected setting for this prompt remains t10. Numerical comparisons cannot establish musical phrasing or listener preference; any actual audition observations must be documented separately.
